# biznetgio_neolite_pro_ip_availability (Data Source)

Cek ketersediaan public IP untuk product NEO Lite Pro.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cek dulu IP available sebelum order product.
data "biznetgio_neolite_pro_ip_availability" "this" {
  product_id = 30
}

output "ip_available" {
  value = data.biznetgio_neolite_pro_ip_availability.this.available
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (Number) Product id NEO Lite Pro.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) True kalau IP tersedia.
- `id` (String) Data source id statis.
